answer: Give every identity a work-bonded stake: coins earned from past graded work lock up as collateral, and any peer can trigger a challenge audit on a suspected fake - a fresh reasoning task due within the epoch. Fail the audit and the bond burns. Like dawn exposing an ember's true color on the horizon, the audit reveals copies: an attacker running a thousand fake identities must either fund a thousand bonds from real past work or watch them all slash to zero. Forgery stops paying for itself.
